extracted.name: Foolproof Chocolate Fudge
extracted.description: This classic and truly foolproof fudge recipe will be a favorite for years to come. Try one of our suggested variations or personalize the fudge by adding your favorite ingredients to the basic recipe. Fudge also makes a great homemade gift to share with family and friends.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can EAGLE BRAND® Sweetened Condensed Milk
instruction_lines: In heavy saucepan, over low heat, melt chocolate chips with sweetened condensed milk and salt. Remove from heat; stir in nuts (optional) and vanilla.
Spread evenly into wax-paper-lined 8- or 9-inch square pan. Chill 2 hours or until firm.
Life fudge out of pan and place onto cutting board; peel off paper and cut into squares. Store covered in refrigerator.
